purpose: Measure the exported receiver against its three-dot predecessor, existing cap and installed Digiten hardware.

comparison.method: Intersect each receiver STL with installed XZ sections. Compare the working-side outline at 138 X positions spanning 83.052 through 98.499 mm on each section.

closing_stop_rays.description: At Y406.5, cast from X97 toward +X through the distal ends of the two wing pockets.

short_upper_wing_at_nominal_cover_pose.method: Section the existing cap in its installed coordinates at Y406.5. Subtract the receiver's upper working-face Z from the unbent wing's inner-face Z. A negative reading is the geometry the spring must clear. Rough supported roads and spring deflection change the hand fit.

centered_seated_cover.method: Return the measured free wing section at Y406.5 to its neutral shape with the coupon cantilever model, including the rotation of each cross-section. Solve each side for the least outward tip spread that clears its fixed cheek. Hold the cover centered at the same +0.0917 mm closing translation used in the previous fit check. Capture is the radial overlap between the retaining lip and the loaded hook nose at X91.10.
centered_seated_cover.scope: These are smooth-CAD positions at a centered seat. Retained support texture changes effective clearance, and the unrestrained cap can shift. Hand force and actual seating require the physical pair.

volume_and_clearance.loading: All installed Digiten bodies preserve their Z coordinates throughout the receiver's X then Y loading stroke.
volume_and_clearance.existing_cap: Every free wing triangle that can reach X91.25 during insertion clears the corresponding splice by at least 0.979 mm in machine Z. Spring spread opens that separation.

support_removal_access.method: Sample 300 area-weighted points on each exposed horizontal floor and cast to machine -X at 0.55 mm into its open side.
